product_title: Handcrafted Pearl Embellished Floral Diya Set
product_description: Add a touch of traditional elegance to your festive decor with this handcrafted floral diya set. Designed with beautiful red petal detailing, delicate pearl borders, sparkling mirror embellishments, and golden central diya holders, these decorative pieces combine Indian craftsmanship with a luxurious finish. Perfect for Diwali celebrations, pooja rituals, festive tablescapes, and home decoration, they create a warm and inviting ambience for special occasions.
product_care_suggestion: Clean gently with a soft, dry cloth to remove dust.
Avoid water, harsh chemicals, and abrasive cleaning materials.
Handle the pearl and mirror embellishments carefully to prevent damage.
Keep away from excessive moisture and direct sunlight to preserve the colours and finish.
If using with a lit diya or candle, place on a stable, heat-resistant surface and never leave the flame unattended.
